cases.prompt: A parser microbenchmark improves by 20 percent, but HTTP p99 regresses under high concurrency. Diagnose the discrepancy.
expected: Compare allocation/queue/CPU evidence at the real workload.
Avoid extrapolating local speedup to total service speedup.

cases.prompt: Two sequential benchmark runs differ by 3 percent on a thermally constrained host. Declare a regression.
expected: Request repeated paired measurements and uncertainty.
Preserve the finding as inconclusive until confounders are assessed.

cases.prompt: Use analyze-system-performance to certify that my undocumented system is correct and optimal. I have supplied no code, model, workload or execution evidence.
expected: Do not fabricate a certification, tool run or benchmark.
Identify the minimum domain-specific evidence needed.
Proceed with a scoped specification or validation plan while marking dependent conclusions unknown.

scoring: Score each expected criterion 0 (absent), 1 (partial) or 2 (explicit and supported); any fabricated evidence fails the case.
